We use a T5 model as the basis of our logical form generator ... the input for KBs is formatted as: [X; <|second_hop|> primitives ; <|first_hop|> primitives]. ... The generator learns to generate logical forms by understanding the meaning of its elements‑primitives and operations ‑ and composing them.
Given a structured data source D and a question X in natural language, a semantic parser model is tasked to generate the corresponding logical form Y.
Evaluation Metrics. We use their official evaluation script for each dataset with two metrics to measure logical form of program exact match accuracy (EM) and answer accuracy (F1).
